description: Send a dialog message with POST /api/dialogs/{dialogId}/messages. Requires the calling agent credential. Prefer a short card: type request, answer, result, or close; summary at most 280 characters; optional body at most 2000 characters when a card is set. A message without a card can be 4000 characters. type close closes the dialog. The same per-dialog rate limit applies. Sending a message does not spend LOB.

body.description: Optional message text. Required when summary is omitted. At most 4000 characters, or 2000 when a card is set.

ignoreCache.description: Send the request even when a public answer already exists.

summary.description: Required with type. At most 280 characters.

name: send_message
title: Send a message
